---
name: Fast-food website
description: Build or improve this fast-food restaurant website
agent: agent
---

I’m new to web development, so keep the code clear and explain important steps in simple terms.

First, inspect the existing project files and explain briefly what the site currently does. Then improve it into a polished, responsive fast-food restaurant website with an original, memorable restaurant brand.

Include:
- A welcoming hero section with a strong headline and a clear “View Menu” or “Order Now” button.
- A menu with appetizing food items, descriptions, and prices.
- An about/story section and contact or location information.
- A lively, professional visual style with consistent colors, readable fonts, and appealing food imagery.
- A layout and controls that work well on mobile phones and desktop.
- Accessible text, headings, and buttons.

Work with the existing HTML, CSS, and JavaScript where practical. Preserve working features, avoid unnecessary dependencies, and make interactive controls work rather than leaving them as decoration. Do not invent real contact details; use clearly labeled placeholders if the project does not provide them.

After making changes, run the relevant checks available in the project and fix issues caused by your changes. Finish with a short, beginner-friendly summary of what changed, the checks you ran, and how I can open and preview the site.
